draft.subject: Photographing Roche and Pierre at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I'm Dan Wright, a concert photographer based here in New York City. I'm writing in regard to the Roche and Pierre Duo at Carnegie Hall on May 18. Carnegie has been my main room for nearly ten years, and I shoot no flash documentary coverage that the audience never notices. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, with the edited gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't already have someone on it, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
